composite_formula: headline = TRUTH-GATED Elo: pairwise LLM-judge Bradley-Terry Elo (3-judge PoLL jury [deepseek-v4-flash, qwen3-max, glm-5], majority vote, position-debiased, 2615 battles) scaled by the grounding gate (mean of reachability% and quote-verified%). Every agent is scored -- nobody is excluded -- but fluent fabrication cannot top the board. Raw judge Elo and grounding are shown alongside; their divergence (raw #1 has ~4% reachable citations) is the headline finding.

deviations.human_zh: 无搜索工具;系统提示提供 shim curl 配方与写文件路径。
deviations.human_en: No search tool; the system prompt supplies the shim curl recipe plus a write-to-file path.

deviations.human_zh: 每主干一个 CCR 实例;运行前断言身份。
deviations.human_en: Per-backbone CCR instance; identity asserted pre-run.

deviations.human_zh: 页面读取经 shell curl 直连、离记录 shim,proof-of-fetch 予以保留(available=False + 原因码),绝不记 0。
deviations.human_en: Page reads go via shell curl direct to the site off the recording shim, so proof-of-fetch is withheld (available=False + reason) and never scored 0.

deviations.human_zh: DeerFlow 的上下文压缩令牌阈值;默认不设,走框架自带的按模型名推断,默认榜上无 harness 额外上限。
deviations.human_en: DeerFlow context-compression token threshold; default unset, so the framework's own model-name inference applies and no harness cap is imposed on the default board.

deviations.human_zh: 页面读取绕过记录 shim,proof-of-fetch 予以保留(available=False + 原因码),绝不因未观测而记 0。
deviations.human_en: Page reads bypass the recording shim, so proof-of-fetch is withheld (available=False + reason) and never scored 0.

deviations.human_zh: FlowSearcher-DS 框架原生预算(每子目标最多3页、每页3000字符、证据总量25000字符、planner 3000令牌、报告8192令牌),内容中立。
deviations.human_en: Framework-native FlowSearcher-DS budgets (<=3 pages per subgoal, 3000 chars/page, 25000 total evidence chars, planner 3000 tokens, report 8192 tokens); content-neutral.

deviations.human_zh: gpt-researcher 的 TavilySearch 检索器被替换为绑定的 shim 后端检索类,使其无法触达真实网络,只经沙盒 shim /search 取结果。
deviations.human_en: gpt-researcher's TavilySearch retriever is replaced by a bound shim-backed retriever class, so it cannot reach the real web and retrieves only through the sandbox shim /search.

deviations.human_zh: 绑定的 shim 检索器只喂片段,任何页面读取仍是 requests 直连、离记录 shim,proof-of-fetch 予以保留,绝不记 0。
deviations.human_en: The bound shim retriever feeds snippets, but any page read is requests direct to the site off the recording shim, so proof-of-fetch is withheld and never scored 0.

deviations.human_zh: 页面读取经 requests 直连、绕过记录 shim,proof-of-fetch 予以保留(available=False + 原因码),绝不记 0。
deviations.human_en: Page reads go via requests direct to the site, bypassing the recording shim, so proof-of-fetch is withheld (available=False + reason) and never scored 0.

deviations.human_zh: 原生 open_deep_research 图保持框架默认预算(并发5、researcher 迭代6、react 工具调用10),各阶段输出仅夹到共享 8192 令牌上限。
deviations.human_en: The native open_deep_research graph keeps its framework defaults (concurrency 5, researcher iterations 6, react tool calls 10); stage outputs are clamped only to the shared 8192-token ceiling.

deviations.human_zh: 架构上无页面读取工具,仅消费搜索片段(fetch_mode: none);引用按 snippet_only 如实归类,与读页车道不同轨。
deviations.human_en: No page-read tool by architecture; consumes search snippets only (fetch_mode: none). Citations classify honestly as snippet_only, a different track from page-reading lanes.

deviations.human_zh: localhost <-> onestopmarket.com 等的掩码,调用前施加、返回后还原;默认关闭(LDR_INTENT_MASK)。
deviations.human_en: localhost <-> onestopmarket.com etc masking, applied before the call and undone after; off by default (LDR_INTENT_MASK).

deviations.human_zh: LDR 使用安装的框架默认:search.iterations=3、questions_per_iteration=1、max_results=50、snippets_only=true;正式运行拒绝任何覆盖。
deviations.human_en: LDR uses its installed framework defaults: search.iterations=3, questions_per_iteration=1, max_results=50, snippets_only=true; every override is rejected for formal runs.

deviations.human_zh: 页面读取传输尚未证明经记录 shim(FETCH_FULL_PAGE 为上游行为),proof-of-fetch 予以保留,待传输冒烟证明后再计,绝不记 0。
deviations.human_en: The page-read transport is not yet proven to pass through the recording shim (FETCH_FULL_PAGE is upstream), so proof-of-fetch is withheld until a transport smoke proves it, and is never scored 0.

deviations.human_zh: 无搜索工具;系统提示提供 shim curl 配方与写文件路径。
deviations.human_en: No search tool; the system prompt supplies the shim curl recipe plus a write-to-file path.

deviations.human_zh: OPENCODE_CONTEXT_LIMIT=40960:告知内联模型的上下文窗口(框架要求的交付),取值匹配主干真实可用窗口,故为对等而非优势。
deviations.human_en: OPENCODE_CONTEXT_LIMIT=40960: the context window opencode is told to assume for the inline model (framework-required delivery); chosen to match the backbone's real usable window, so on par rather than an advantage.

deviations.human_zh: 被教了 shim /fetch 配方,但命令白名单也放行 curl localhost,页面可能离 shim 读取;proof-of-fetch 予以保留,待白名单收紧,绝不记 0。
deviations.human_en: Taught the shim /fetch recipe, but its command allowlist also permits curl to localhost, so a page can be read off-shim; proof-of-fetch is withheld until the allowlist is tightened, and never scored 0.

deviations.human_zh: 原生 qx DeepResearcher 经本地 shim 翻译层接入 SearchXNG,解析 shim 仅剥除 <think> 包裹,不伪造回退对象。
deviations.human_en: Native qx DeepResearcher reaches SearchXNG through a local shim translator; the parser shim strips only <think> wrappers and fabricates no fallback objects.

deviations.human_zh: 框架原生预算:max_iterations=5、max_time_minutes=10、max_turns=10、SearchXNG pageLength=10。
deviations.human_en: Framework-native budgets: max_iterations=5, max_time_minutes=10, openai-agents max_turns=10, SearchXNG pageLength=10.

deviations.human_zh: 页面读取经 aiohttp 直连、绕过记录 shim,proof-of-fetch 予以保留(available=False + 原因码),绝不记 0。
deviations.human_en: Page reads go via aiohttp direct to the site, bypassing the recording shim, so proof-of-fetch is withheld (available=False + reason) and never scored 0.

deviations.human_zh: SMOLAGENTS_MAX_STEPS=20:smolagents ToolCallingAgent 的原生代理循环步数上限(框架构造器默认)。
deviations.human_en: SMOLAGENTS_MAX_STEPS=20: the smolagents ToolCallingAgent agentic-loop cap (the framework constructor's native default).

deviations.human_zh: SMOLAGENTS_SEARCH_MAX_RESULTS=6:我们 ShimSearchTool 每次 /search 传入的结果条数(harness 施加),低于若干 CLI/原生车道请求的 10。
deviations.human_en: SMOLAGENTS_SEARCH_MAX_RESULTS=6: results-per-search our ShimSearchTool wrapper passes to shim /search (harness-imposed), lower than the 10 several CLI and native lanes request.

deviations.human_zh: SMOLAGENTS_SEARCH_SNIPPET_CHARS=650:每条结果模型可见的片段长度;SMOLAGENTS_MIN_REPORT_CHARS=3500 仅作诊断,不替代真实报告。
deviations.human_en: SMOLAGENTS_SEARCH_SNIPPET_CHARS=650: per-result snippet length the model sees; SMOLAGENTS_MIN_REPORT_CHARS=3500 is diagnostic only and cannot replace a short real report.

deviations.human_zh: VisitWebpageTool 走 requests 直连;重写门仅在 --strict-sandbox 下安装,默认榜上读取离 shim,proof-of-fetch 予以保留,绝不记 0。
deviations.human_en: The VisitWebpageTool reads via requests direct; the rewrite gate is installed only under --strict-sandbox, so on the default board the read is off-shim and proof-of-fetch is withheld, never scored 0.

deviations.human_en: STORM's post-retrieval SentenceTransformer index is replaced by a deterministic lexical scorer (the offline worker has no embedding-model download channel); other research budgets stay framework-native.
